agenda_text:
July 21, 2021
8:45
AM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4, 2024 OF
THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF
THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes preparation.
The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Committee meetings.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Support Services Director to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the Committee Secretary at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may
observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86865047991
Zoom Meeting ID: 868 6504 7991
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 868 6504 7991#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to pvefinance@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all committee members. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the Committee Members, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the Finance Advisory Committee during the meeting, please email pvefinance@pvestates.org by 4:00 p.m. on Wednesday, July 21, 2021 with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will be calling in to the meeting.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Finance Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATION FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items that are NOT on the agenda. According to state law, no action can be taken by the Finance Advisory Committee on matters presented under this section.
OLD BUSINESS
1.
Meet new FAC member
NEW BUSINESS
2.
Review of Roles and Responsibilities and the Finance Advisory Committee Work plan.
Recommendation: That the Committee review the roles and responsibilities of the Finance Advisory Committee and review the Finance Advisory Committee’s work plan.
Roles and Responsibilities
FAC Work Plan
3.
Consideration of the formation of FAC ADHOC Committees.
Recommendation: That the Committee considers the formation of Finance Advisory Committee ADHOC Committees.
4.
Council Action – Allocation of resources to unmet needs.
Recommendation: Discuss the item and make recommendations to the City Council as deemed appropriate.
5.
Staff financial update.
ADJOURNMENT TO OCTOBER 20, 2021 AT 6:00 P.M.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by the front door at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City’s Website (pvestates.org) not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54956. Dated this 31st day of October 2024.Tameka Cook, City Clerk
